comments.body:
Thanks for your patience as we ramp back into things after the end of year holidays!

The release repository above has been imported into ros2-gbp. I recommend archiving https://github.com/fmrico/cascade_lifecycle-release.git so that it remains available for anyone using an earlier ros/rosdistro index but cannot be pushed to by mistake.
